title: Personalization
backgroundLearning: Learn vocabulary from corrections in the background
backgroundHelp: Off by default. For up to one minute after dictation, Handy watches only the nonsecure field where its text was inserted. Small spelling corrections become local vocabulary hints. Nothing is sent to an AI provider. Observation stops when you change fields, start another recording, or turn this off. Review or undo learned words below.
backgroundPending: Learned locally from your edit · awaiting review
snippetHelp: Say a trigger phrase to insert its exact plain text. Longer phrases take priority. Inserted text is never expanded again.
learningHelp: Edit a saved transcript, review the changed phrase, then confirm a vocabulary hint or an exact replacement. The original history stays unchanged. Only confirmed learning affects future dictation.
emptyLearning: No confirmed vocabulary or replacements yet.
